requirement.description: The next_token function has issues with parsing incomplete tokens, particularly for integers and names at the end of input. When parsing fails due to incomplete data, it returns None for the token type instead of returning the appropriate type.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must correctly identify and return token types for incomplete inputs. For example, when parsing an incomplete integer or name at the end of a string, it should return the appropriate token type ('INTEGER', 'NAME', etc.) rather than None.

requirement.description: The next_token function doesn't correctly handle the case where a stream ends without a proper endstream marker, causing it to return incorrect positions for the stream content.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must properly identify and return the correct content of a stream when it encounters a stream marker and correctly identifies the endstream marker.

requirement.description: The next_token function doesn't correctly process comments, causing failures in parsing when comments are present in the input.
requirement.contract: The next_token function must properly recognize and return COMMENT tokens when encountering a '%' character at the beginning of a token.

requirement.description: The parse_obj function has issues with handling integer tokens that appear to be references but are not properly detected due to parsing errors in the next_token function.
requirement.contract: The parse_obj function must correctly detect and convert integer tokens followed by '0 R' into complex number representations (e.g., 6j) when parsing dictionary values and arrays.

requirement.description: The build_chrono_from_xref function fails to properly parse xref tables due to incorrect handling of the startxref position and token parsing.
requirement.contract: The build_chrono_from_xref function must correctly parse xref tables and streams by properly extracting the startxref position and parsing xref data correctly.
